recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit. No FHIR-core source follow-up is needed for FHIR-24350; generated diagrams or rendered artifacts can be regenerated by the normal build if they lag behind the authoritative XML and narrative.
issue_request: FHIR-24350 was Published/Persuasive with Modification for R5 and asked Topic.canFilterBy.matchType to specify what happens when the field is absent. The accepted resolution renamed matchType to modifier, kept it optional, and defined the missing case as search without a modifier.
initial_application: Commit c28bb50bd49d88fdafe62b24a14d4f3f44c7930b added SubscriptionTopic filter documentation for FHIR-24350, including text that a missing search modifier defaults to =, meaning no modifier. FHIR-23738's Argonaut subscription merge comment explicitly lists FHIR-24350 as the source for adding the SubscriptionTopic filter documentation, and the Jira comment says the change was verified in R4B and R5.
additional_context: The current resource is SubscriptionTopic and is active in source/fhir.ini. Later source evolution moved canFilterBy under SubscriptionTopic.trigger. FHIR-39026 revisited the same =/eq/defaulting area and resolved it by splitting SearchParameter-like comparator and modifier elements rather than making modifier mandatory; the combined branch already contains an FHIR-39026 audit commit. FHIR-50614 later broadened modifier value-set coverage for :type resource values and is also already represented on the combined branch. Confluence minutes confirm FHIR-24350 was deferred until the Argonaut SubscriptionTopic changes and then applied, while Zulip evidence records the model rename and no conflicting FHIR-24350 discussion was found.
reconciliation: No source change was needed. The current StructureDefinition has optional comparator and modifier children under SubscriptionTopic.trigger.canFilterBy, and the SubscriptionTopic narrative explicitly says that if no comparator or modifier is provided, the comparison is the default = match. This conveys the accepted FHIR-24350 behavior: filtering without a modifier uses normal search semantics.
